allow: Shell(sleep 1; B=http://localhost:4000/api echo "--- register doctor ---" DR=$(curl -s -X POST $B/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Dr. Sarah Khan","email":"sarah@clinic.com","password":"password123","role":"DOCTOR","bmdcId":"BMDC-1001","specialty":"Cardiology","consultationFee":1200,"bio":"Senior cardiologist"}') echo "$DR" | head -c 400; echo # grab doctor profile id + token DPID=$(echo "$DR" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(j.data.user.doctorProfile.id)})") DTOK=$(echo "$DR" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(j.data.token)})") echo "doctorProfileId=$DPID" echo "--- admin verify doctor directly (bypass admin route for now) ---" node -e "require('dotenv').config();const {PrismaClient}=require('@prisma/client');const p=new PrismaClient();p.doctorProfile.update({where:{id:'$DPID'},data:{verificationStatus:'VERIFIED'}}).then(r=>{console.log('verified',r.verificationStatus);return p.\$disconnect()})" echo "--- register patient ---" PT=$(curl -s -X POST $B/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Rahim Uddin","email":"rahim@mail.com","password":"password123","role":"PATIENT","address":"Dhaka"}') PTOK=$(echo "$PT" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(j.data.token)})") echo "patient token ok: ${#PTOK} chars" echo "--- list verified doctors ---" curl -s "$B/doctors?specialty=Cardiology" | head -c 300; echo echo "--- create appointment ---" curl -s -X POST $B/appointments -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"doctorId\":\"$DPID\",\"scheduledAt\":\"2026-08-20T10:00:00Z\",\"type\":\"VIDEO\"}"; echo echo "--- list patient appointments ---" curl -s "$B/appointments" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" | head -c 300; echo echo "--- doctor confirms ---" AID=$(curl -s "$B/appointments" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{console.log(JSON.parse(s).data.appointments[0].id)})") curl -s -X PATCH $B/appointments/$AID/status -H "Authorization: Bearer $DTOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"CONFIRMED"}' | head -c 200; echo echo "--- patient cancels a second appointment ---" curl -s -X POST $B/appointments -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"doctorId\":\"$DPID\",\"scheduledAt\":\"2026-08-21T11:00:00Z\",\"type\":\"IN_PERSON\"}" >/dev/null AID2=$(curl -s "$B/appointments" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const l=JSON.parse(s).data.appointments;console.log(l.find(a=>a.status==='PENDING').id)})") curl -s -X PATCH $B/appointments/$AID2/status -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"CANCELLED"}' | head -c 200; echo echo "--- patient tries to confirm (should 400) ---" curl -s -X PATCH $B/appointments/$AID/status -H "Authorization: Bearer $PTOK" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"CONFIRMED"}'; echo)

Shell(node -e  require('dotenv').config(); const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const p = new PrismaClient(); (async () => { const d = await p.doctorProfile.findFirst({ where: { user: { email: 'sarah@clinic.com' } } }); await p.doctorProfile.update({ where: { id: d.id }, data: { verificationStatus: 'VERIFIED' } }); console.log('verified', d.id); await p.$disconnect(); })(); )
